page.overview:
Who is Candy Box Man?

Candy Box man is a character who appears in "Lady Rainicorn Of The Crystal Dimension" when T.V. attempts to sell the Crystal Mergence of Destruction's box to him, which he refused due to it not being a candy box.

Candy Box Man looks very similar to the Townspeople from "His Hero", with his green skin and white eyes, wearing a brown cloak with a hood and a dark brown shirt under the cloak.
